parameters.query:
SELECT
    (
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM wallet_transaction_logs
            WHERE external_transaction_id = '{{$json.external_transaction_id}}'
              AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'DUPLICATE')
        )
        OR
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM wallet_transaction_logs
            WHERE customer_code = '{{$json.customer_code}}'
              AND lead_id = '{{$json.lead_id}}'
              AND remarks = '{{($json.remarks || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}'
              AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'DUPLICATE')
        )
    ) AS exists;

/* SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM wallet_transaction_logs
  WHERE customer_code = '{{$json.customer_code}}'
  AND remarks = '{{$json.remarks}}'
  AND status = 'SUCCESS'
); */

/* SELECT status
FROM wallet_transaction_logs
WHERE customer_code = '{{$json.customer_code}}'
AND remarks = '{{$json.remarks}}'
AND status = 'SUCCESS'
LIMIT 1; */

INSERT INTO wallet_transaction_logs (
    customer_code,
    lead_id,
    amount,
    remarks,
    reference_id,
    transaction_note,
    status,
    status_code,
    message,
    request_payload,
    response_payload,
    execution_id,
    rule_name,
    n8n_rule_id,
    category,
    external_transaction_id,
    organization_id,
    organization_name,
    created_at,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    '{{$json.customer_code}}',
    '{{$json.lead_id}}',
    {{$json.amount || 0}},
    '{{($json.remarks || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    {{$json.reference_id ? `'${$json.reference_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
    '{{($json.transaction_note || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    '{{($json.status || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    {{$json.status_code || 500}},
    '{{($json.message || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    '{{JSON.stringify($json.request_payload || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb,
    '{{JSON.stringify($json.response_payload || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb,
    {{$json.execution_id ? `'${$json.execution_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
    '{{($json.rule_name || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    {{$json.n8n_rule_id ? `'${$json.n8n_rule_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
    '{{($json.category || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    '{{($json.external_transaction_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    {{$json.organization_id || 'NULL'}},
    '{{($json.organization_name || "").replace(/'/g, "''")}}',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
);
